issue.title: Collection cards adopt the title block: album, record, and bank cards wear their species, and album and record cards own the note title from the title slot
issue.description: On desktop Obsidian, every album note and record note opens on its card in the title slot above native Properties, and that card is the note's only visible title. The album card paints its title from local data at once, hides its redundant H1 at render time, and folds its schema to one line. The record card carries the RECORD kicker, a sheet tile, and paper material, with its walk rail docked at its bottom. The bank Setup card gains the BANK kicker and tile. The Record Card and album card editor headers show the species tile and word. Every failure restores native rendering.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/collection_cards_title_block.md requests this work

payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: bob-cli docs/reference/vault-format.md is over its word budget (6016 > 6000 for reference/) on bob-cli master 2443e0a4 — bob-plugins `npm run docs:check` (BOB_CLI_DIR set) fails on it with a clean bob-plugins tree; no bead tracks it.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: real-Obsidian Ctrl+J/Ctrl+K group/field jumps fail in card editors — bank Setup e2e setup-group-jump-ctrl-k and album UI e2e schema-field-jump-ctrl-j (real key moved=false) fail identically on clean bob-plugins c5f5a1b; untracked.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: obsidian-bank-ui-e2e-setup.cjs aborts at "timed out waiting for bank arrangement saved after one Enter" (state preview-ready, dirty) and setup-arrange-dry-run-budget times out on preview 2 in 2 of 3 runs, all on clean c5f5a1b too; the abort skips every later Setup e2e section (processFrontMatter header, plugin-disabled), so those go unverified.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: obsidian-bank-ui-e2e.cjs fails queue-card-live/queue-card-reading ("missing import command"), invalid-fence, and walk-learn-coffee/walk-learn-accept (RangeError: Invalid line number 0) with identical verdicts on clean c5f5a1b; untracked.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: in Live Preview the bank card is an inline widget at the end of the `# 🏦 Bank` line, so it inherits the H1 font size (head, collapsed line, and buttons render at heading size; pre-existing on c5f5a1b); the new BANK badge uses --font-ui-small and reads small beside it. Consider a block widget or resetting font-size on .bob-bank-setup.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: obsidian-album-ui-e2e.cjs default executable /snap/obsidian/current/app/obsidian exits before the fixture vault window on athena ("owned Obsidian process exited"), as does obsidian-bank-ui-e2e.cjs with that path; -e /snap/bin/obsidian works. Default the album e2e to /snap/bin/obsidian or document it.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: bob-plugins album UI e2e check schema-field-jump-ctrl-j fails on athena (real Ctrl+J sent through CDP Input.dispatchKeyEvent does not move the album card editor selection; the synthetic keydown fallback does). It fails identically on a clean origin/master worktree (121 checks, same single failure), so it is not caused by the album card. No tracking bead found.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: scripts/obsidian-album-schema-writer-e2e.cjs --self-test with BOB_BIN=bob 0.5.0 fails with 'held-lock apply must create exactly one commit, saw 2'. It fails identically on a clean bob-plugins origin/master, so it is bob writer behavior (likely the album write plus a post-sync commit), not this phase. No tracking bead found.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: bob-cli docs gate fails: docs/reference/vault-format.md is over budget at 6016 words (cap 6000 for reference/) since bob-cli bb91c370 (albums tidy). npm run docs:check fails identically from a clean bob-plugins origin/master; the bob-plugins pages pass. Trim vault-format.md or split it.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: in Live Preview the blank lines around a hidden album H1 stay visible as empty lines (about two lines between native Properties and the first body content on eat.md). The kit range (240h propertyCardTitleSourceRangeFromLines) ends at the H1 unless a follower line follows, while the design contract says the title block includes the blank lines that follow. Consider letting the kit swallow trailing (and leading) blank lines for recognizers without followers; 240h is shared with the day and period cards, so change it in one kit phase.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: scripts/obsidian-album-ui-e2e.cjs passes process.env.TMPDIR to Obsidian; under SASE the agent TMPDIR is long enough that Chromium aborts with 'Socket path too long ... SingletonSocket' and the run fails with 'owned Obsidian process exited while waiting for the fixture vault window'. preview-property-cards.cjs already pins TMPDIR=/tmp in its spawn env; the album e2e (and likely the other Obsidian e2e harnesses) should do the same. Workaround used here: TMPDIR=/tmp in the command.

Album card is the title block. bob-plugins commit 'feat(ledger-tools): album card owns the title block from the title slot' lands at this turn's finalization; bob-ledger-tools 1.147.0 (o6.4.1.3 f16ddea and o6.5 eed318e both shipped 1.146.0, merged here). Kit additions are additive: adopter glue 240k-plugin-property-card-title-adopt.js + exports 374c (240j/374b were taken by the bank-and-editors identity badge); o6.5 built its own 296d controller, so no glue to reuse. Album: notebookHeaderNoteTitle album rule (valid title:, H1 before ##/column-0 bullet, alias, humanized stem), local identity + card model, kit title block (stack tile, ALBUM kicker links with modifier-aware opener, title, summary subtitle, actions on the kicker row), body joins in place, record row hides only after the body, healthy schema folds to one line. Walker-footer album title aligned to the rule; 291h unchanged (Gmail subject/title, not an album reader). Dispose scope verified: every host dispose runs only from teardownLedgerToolsSurfaces() in onunload(), so no scoping change. Gates: build and build:check pass; npm test green on the f16ddea-merged tree (7929/7929); on the final eed318e-merged tree 7948/7949, the one failure the frees-marks 25 ms budget (bob-cli-io), 3/3 in isolation. docs:check fails only on bob-cli docs/reference/vault-format.md over budget, identical on clean origin/master (follow-up). Real Obsidian on athena (TMPDIR=/tmp, bob 0.5.0): album UI e2e 129/130, the only failure schema-field-jump-ctrl-j, identical on clean master (follow-up); report file:explicit:5911d19e7c9aae058cbad08d; shots Reading file:explicit:63b2e58aa15bb66b78b40933, Live file:explicit:0db478a43c806e285e9af985, 375px file:explicit:cc79220b38c7fa09e7f2b143, reveal file:explicit:34d56e5c34205c66a34ba821. vim-yank-flash --only geometry passes 23 cases incl. the album header case. album-schema-writer self-test fails identically on master (follow-up). Previews: ADOPTED_KINDS merged {bank, album}; structural 20/20, gated record/bank 8/8 pixel-identical; report file:explicit:c1d737b81078a806eca0ce52, index file:explicit:9bff905d85249923b188a56d. Changed e2e expectations: assertHeaderIntegrity(probe, {title}) now checks title slot, before Properties, data-card-kind, 'Album: <title>', hidden inline title, one visible aria-level=1; new checks reading-h1-hidden, card-identity, schema-fold-default, live-h1-hidden-and-revealed, post-tidy-title-hides-nothing, preview/live title-block-before-report and body-joins-same-node; h1less-album.md gains title: Bites (post-tidy shape). Unit expectation changes: healthy summary starts folded; an unchanged repaint keeps node and focus; the Live Preview switch fixture changes text with path. Deploy: sync refused because o6.5's pre-rebase dirty build was deployed and its bytes are in no commit; rebuilding eed318e's changes on 9b3c339 reproduced the deployed main.js and styles.css byte for byte and the manifest equals eed318e's, so per deployment.md I deployed clean eed318e with -F (backup kept), then synced 1.147.0 without -F; vault main.js, styles.css, manifest.json byte-identical to the build. No memory edits, no new beads.

Bank and card-editor species badges shipped in bob-plugins commit f16ddea (bob-ledger-tools 1.146.0), now on origin/master. The species identity badge (fragment 240j, export propertyCardBuildIdentityBadge) appears on the bank Setup card head row (data-card-kind=bank, bank tile + BANK) and on the Record Card and album card editor headers (sheet tile + RECORD, stack tile + ALBUM, above an emoji-free title). Deploy: after bob-cli-o6.5 closed, the vault already held a later dirty bob-cli_13 build. That agent landed it as a68e29b (album title block, 1.147.0), which descends from f16ddea. A clean checkout at a68e29b passed npm run build and build:check, dry-run and real bob plugins sync -p bob-ledger-tools reported up to date (0 copied, no refusal, no -F), and the stamp now reads clean at a68e29b. Vault main.js, styles.css, and manifest.json sha256 match the checkout, deployed version 1.147.0, and the deployed main.js contains the badge code. eed318e and a68e29b changed no bank, badge, Record Card, or album-editor source (they overlap only in generated files), so the bank Setup e2e was not rerun. The touched suites pass 167/167 on a68e29b. Gates on our tree: npm test green except tracked load flakes bob-cli-io and bob-cli-lp. docs:check fails only on bob-cli's vault-format.md word budget, which fails on base too (recorded as a follow-up). Real-Obsidian e2e: Bank Setup 48 pass, all 4 badge checks pass, its 2 failures and early abort also on base. Bank UI 73 pass, 5 failures identical on base. Album UI 120/121, the 1 failure also on base. Record Card 144/144. Artifacts: file:explicit:c18918352df0c879b13cfa09, file:explicit:74d6baad122ff5d4a098008d, file:explicit:06ac5bda11561f50cbb70939, file:explicit:f9426b02e3616fb0a9bd0b33. No epic symbols; no memory edits.
